text: Walk me through the ILO Article 24 + Article 26 complaint procedures available to a workers' organization alleging non-compliance with C189 by a state party. (a) Who has standing; (b) the Committee of Experts on the Application of Conventions and Recommendations (CEACR) review path; (c) the Conference Committee on the Application of Standards (CAS) escalation; (d) the realistic outcome — what's the strongest enforcement mechanism the ILO has.

ASEAN ACTIP Art. 23-25 invocation: a Cambodian compound trafficked Filipino workers; the operators are Chinese nationals with Cambodian residency. Walk through: (a) the Mutual Legal Assistance procedure under ACTIP, (b) the parallel UNODC Bali Process channel, (c) which ASEAN Member State has primary investigatory jurisdiction, (d) the extradition obstacles + workarounds (the China non-extradition issue), (e) the operational coordination (PH PAOCC + Cambodian NCCT + Chinese MPS).
